seismic_pga_2pct_50yr_g.dataset_vintage: USGS 2023 Conterminous U.S. NSHM (uniform-hazard ground motion maps, VS30=760 B/C; DOI 10.5066/P9GNPCOD)

fire_hazard_severity_zone_class.dataset_vintage: CAL FIRE OSFM LRA FHSZ (recommended), map dated 2025-03-24, all 4 rollout phases
fire_hazard_severity_zone_class.notes: CAL FIRE LRA Fire Hazard Severity Zone at the point (FHSZ code -3); read with fire_hazard_responsibility_area, which decides what the class legally means.
